test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_review_growing_overlap_{n} (id UInt64, p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_review_growing_overlap_{n} SELECT number, [ [(0.,0.),(0.,8.),(1.5 * {n} + 5,8.),(1.5 * {n} + 5,0.),(0.,0.)], [(1.5 * number + 1,1. + number % 2),(1.5 * number + 3,1. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 3,4. + number % 2),(1.5 * number + 1,4. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 1,1. + number % 2)] ] FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_review_growing_overlap_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionMerge(s) FROM ( SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionState(p) AS s FROM bench_review_growing_overlap_{n} GROUP BY intDiv(id,32) ) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
